title: Open future, supervaluationism and the growing-block theory: a stage-theoretical account
locator: Selected HTML sections: Introduction; Stage setting; All the stages of temporal passage; opening of reply to Correia–Rosenkranz; Quantifier troubles through stage-shifting repair

proof_status: Displayed clauses and objection read; entire quantified framework not independently reproduced.
open_questions: How to adapt stage shifts to partially ordered relativistic standpoints without assuming a preferred global present?

limits: Selected full-text reading only; attributed objections are not our independently established verdict on rival theories.

title: Symmetries and ground
assumptions: Grounding explanations, relevant symmetry principles; noneliminativist target.
conclusion: Author argues against certain reductions; fragmentalist response and unpruned explanation caveat.
proof_status: Time application and note25 checked; general grounding machinery not fully audited.
open_questions: What is the full explanandum for consistent standpoint-relative realism?
relevance: Blocks an overquick symmetry objection and separates truth conditions from grounds.
limits: Incompatible-fact fragmentalism must not be identified with our consistent core; no conclusion that our metaphysics is supported.
